description: A biomechanical engineer needs a specific cortical bone segmentation for a Finite Element Analysis simulation. The default bone settings include too much spongy bone. Your task is to load the CT Cranium dataset (already available), create a segmentation mask, and iteratively adjust the threshold (Min HU) until the total mask volume is strictly between 250,000 mm³ and 350,000 mm³. Check the volume in the mask information panel after each adjustment. Save the final project to /home/ga/Documents/cortical_study.inv3.
